title: Reordered rank-pair regions: conditional κ = 5.1028985071975e-5
body:
## Conditional bound

This contribution gives **κ = 2041159402879/(4×10^16) = 5.1028985071975×10⁻⁵**, approximately **0.00277315% above #63**, under the inherited analytic, all-size compiler and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses. The bit saving is **5103158916233/10^17**.

The subsequently posted #64 refines the same #63 profiles to κ = 5.10275840622536575×10⁻⁵; this new schedule witness also exceeds that reported bound by approximately 0.00274559%. This is a numerical bound comparison, not a comparison of the strength of #64’s independent verification and formalization. See the pinned `current-comparison.json`.

## Change

Keep #63's scalar graph and rank-first retired-slot selection. Change the order of regions within each rank: increasing cover/core at h=23 and decreasing minimum node index at h=25. Each schedule is checked to be topological and to preserve forward carrier candidates. This changes the physical frame paths and complete fixed-basis child distribution. It does not remove paid clearing, copied centers or endpoint corrections.

The roles remain 27,918 and 36,586; W remains 137,151,806. The construction gain is combined with tighter exact Taylor enclosures and finer rational grids, retaining the original backoff h=10^-12. The proof note separates these contributions; no global optimality or practical speedup is claimed.

## Validation

Both dimensions passed full dirty-basis checks in both orientations, independent serialized-word replay, and fixed-basis profile regeneration. Exact moment enclosures, all 47 strict constraints and seven margins, and rejection of the next grid points pass. An independent logarithm/Taylor computation checks the arithmetic.

**Full `make verify` PASSED** on research commit `49e84f939d15b618b50714eb039cabf97c74256a` in **23m 30s**: 467 core unit tests, all 20 historical patch checks, complete physical word/profile regeneration, six physical negative controls and eight arithmetic tests. All **32 GitHub CI jobs** on that head also passed. Receipt: `research/reordered-rank-pair/validation.json`; log SHA256 `accde9848e886d6c7802a14d4ac415c1b0c2e5ce049868d5b8c2c150c1e74f76`.

Upstream `main` was integrated afterward to resolve concurrent merge conflicts. All consumed source code, physical witnesses and numeric proofs are unchanged; focused metadata/hash/profile composition and arithmetic checks passed. Newly imported upstream groups are preserved in the expanded CI matrix and were not part of the earlier local full run.

The first expanded CI run exposed stale joint-dual hashes for Makefile, README and NOTICE. Those three reviewed source pins and their two derived metadata hashes have been refreshed. The complete `make verify-joint` now passes, including both physical compiler rebuilds and ten negative controls; all numerical and physical certificate fields are unchanged. The replacement GitHub joint checks passed on Python 3.11, 3.13 and 3.14 at `b0cea06d7fd5ac10f76169b01d3114f208fc7448` ([run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/37828487972)).

Run `make reordered-rank-pair-verify`. See `research/reordered-rank-pair/README.md` for the general argument, source pins, negative controls and limitations.
